## What's new

Threadnote 5.0.6 keeps code-graph discovery available during background refresh, with resilient scoped recovery that preserves the latest requested work after interruptions.

### Reliable graph discovery during refresh

MCP graph reads can continue to use ready snapshots while refresh maintenance runs in the background. Responses now retain bounded recovery state when a refresh cannot complete, so agents can distinguish available discovery from work that still requires current evidence.

### Safer background recovery

Watcher recovery now coalesces repeated scoped resume requests, keeps only the latest pending target, and safely hands work off even when the caller is interrupted. This avoids duplicate resume work while retaining explicit failure metadata for recovery.
